desc: Star spirit mage: violet and blue tattered cloak with cyan trim, three stacked layers of translucent butterfly wings on each side, holds a staff topped with a star crystal. Glowing cyan eyes. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big hooded head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px dark outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Hood interior is a solid black void with only two small glowing eyes.
